records.text: Unnamed donors who attended the Aspen event told Candace Owens that the recording presented as Charlie Kirk appointing Erika Kirk as successor was AI-generated
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep qZ8RWfyuewQ)

appearances.snippet: I am saying that donors are telling us that that was an AI video or an AI audio that you presented of Charlie Kirk. ... I spoke to multiple donors that were at that event.

verification.notes: Owens says multiple unnamed Aspen donors told her the succession recording was AI-generated, but no donor is identified and current searches found no authenticated forensic analysis or named eyewitness evidence. The anonymous allegation is therefore attempted but unverifiable.

conveyance.original_source: Unnamed donor communications to Candace Owens
